notes.title: Patch v1.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added missing collision on objects in the forest path
[*] Fixed some instances of weird interactive range on objects
[*] Fixed some minor misspellings
[*] Fixed bugged audio near dynamite plunger
[*] Fixed bugged audio inside the farm house save room
[*] Reworked various music tracks
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted several cameras in the old farm to provide a better playing experience
[*] Fixed some instances of the player being able to leave the viewable area in certain locations
[*] Fixed the player's control returning too early when interacting with the doll
[*] Added the ability to display the controls during gameplay
[*] Skipping cutscenes now requires the player to hold the action key
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added turning animation and increased turning speed
[*] Made it easier and more intuitive to read notes
[*] Added checkpoint in the forest trail and old farm
[*] Fixed music tracks overlapping when exiting the guest house
[*] Increased the volume of the monsters audio
[/list]
